production_scope.note: Portrait compositions are intentionally not generated in this batch.

continuity.palette_arc: Begin with restrained battle ochres and earth greens; turn to milky cream, mineral blue and muted rose for the divine assembly; shift to the deep maroon and cream of Mathura; end with gentle indigo, ivory and warm ochre pregnancy symbolism.
continuity.narrative_arc: The returning Asura burden drives Bhūdevī to Brahma; the devas seek Hari's aid; the incarnation plan is revealed; Vasudeva and Devaki marry; Kamsa hears the prophecy, relents, is warned by Narada and grows fearful; the seventh embryo moves to Rohini and Hari enters Devaki.
continuity.notes: Use the actual stanza-specific source text and only its mapped supplied photograph as narrative reference. Photos 011–012 are unmapped documentary extras. English Facebook captions remain attributed commentary, not translations. All image work is unapproved comparison art. Use D001 S004/S008 only for flat opaque mineral-matte rendering; no glossy shading, metallic gold, outer border or readable text. Identity references do not license importing their rendering. Do not place a Krishna peacock feather on other deities. Preserve natural human anatomy and clear contacts; Brahma's four heads and four arms are intentional per his approved character contract. Portraits paused. No scene depicts Vrindavan-period youthful Krishna: S005 shows a four-armed Hari vision using approved Guruvayurappan identity only, while S010 uses symbolic light without a youthful Krishna figure.

character_contracts.bhudevi-d037: A dignified adult Earth Goddess with natural proportions and exactly two attached arms. Show distress without injury. Warm cream, muted ochre and restrained earth-green sari; no Varaha, globe, tusk or duplicated Earth-Goddess symbol. This D037 scene contract supersedes the unrelated recovery-scene pose in the general Bhūdevī sheet only for these scenes.
character_contracts.brahma: Use approved character bible: exactly four heads and four attached arms, three faces visible from a frontal view, rear face turned away; no extra faces or hands.
character_contracts.guruvayurappan: Use only approved Guruvayurappan identity cues for the small four-armed Hari vision in S005; the D001 S004/S008 references govern rendering separately. Four arms are intentional and attached. No Krishna feather, gloss or metallic finish.
character_contracts.shiva-d037: Mature ash-toned ascetic deity, natural adult proportions, two attached arms, calm guiding presence, simple ochre cloth and restrained rudraksha; a single trident may be carried upright. No Krishna feather, glossy blue skin or more than two arms.
character_contracts.kamsa-d037: One recurring adult Mathuran king with natural proportions, exactly two attached arms, strong but human face, dark hair and restrained maroon/ochre royal cloth. Portray menace through expression and gesture, never monstrous anatomy. No injury or blood; in stanza 8 he spares the child; in stanza 9 the violence is symbolic and off-screen.
character_contracts.rohini-d037: Adult woman with natural proportions, exactly two attached arms, modest warm-cream and muted-green sari, composed face; show only symbolic light arriving at her, without anatomy of pregnancy or exposed body.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #1 to 001.jpg (SHA-256 b00b3e13c4a8b570f299468645ccae36c4db2f66a78571f1be43b9ee78c0fcc4). Image shows armored figures in battle; reinterpret only the stanza's recurring Asura burden, not the exact fantasy armor or fire effects.

must_show: A quiet aftermath of conflict suggested by distant small silhouettes, not a foreground battle
Bhūdevī as the clear focal figure approaching Brahma's lotus abode
A small group of devas already gathered as witnesses
Earth represented by the goddess and landscape, never a second globe
scene_brief.composition: Wide horizontal procession from the burdened land toward the lotus seat; keep the goddess's face, hands and path readable.
avoid: fantasy armor or fire borrowed from the reference

stanzas.alt: Bhūdevī seeks refuge with Brahma as the devas gather at his abode

landscape.composition_override: Use a broad grounded horizon and side-to-side approach to the lotus abode; compose a complete new landscape.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #2 to 002.jpg (SHA-256 df2d32a89acd2e3b69f121fe4fd003b8582e07532d8fe7e650ab5c84d4e909ca). Use the ocean and endangered-Earth idea only; exclude stock watermarks and copied pose.

must_show: Bhūdevī safely on a receding shore, pleading to Brahma
A symbolic rising waterline communicating the danger of sinking
Brahma looking toward the devas and turning inward in meditation on Hari
Brahma with exactly four heads and four arms per approved contract
scene_brief.composition: The goddess and Brahma form a clear exchange above a quiet symbolic ocean; keep the deva witnesses distinct and secondary.
avoid: Bhūdevī inside water or being harmed

stanzas.alt: Brahma turns to Hari in meditation as Bhūdevī pleads beside the rising ocean

landscape.composition_override: Compose the shore, goddess, Brahma and witnesses across a broad horizontal axis with safe space around every figure.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #3 to 003.jpg (SHA-256 eb81a752a5a22064b7f506514e4830881742cbbbffa76a1b7a830a07e18418a6). Treat it as a broad assembly cue only; do not copy its deity poses or photoreal glow.

must_show: Shiva leading a small orderly assembly toward the milky ocean
Brahma, Bhūdevī and a few devas following
A distant calm ocean shore suggesting refuge at Hari's abode
Distinct natural two-arm humanlike anatomy for all except Brahma's contracted four arms
scene_brief.composition: A lateral traveling group moves toward an open pale horizon; no crowd duplication or tangled limbs.
avoid: Krishna peacock feather on Shiva or Brahma

stanzas.alt: Shiva leads Brahma, Bhūdevī and the devas toward the milky ocean

landscape.composition_override: Build a low, sideward procession with the ocean destination visible ahead and figures separated by clear negative space.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #4 to 004.jpg (SHA-256 3867db905aa8d71aa1f97b6bddaa0c638f65dc95dd905bdcf57543f53bcd55a3). Reference is a Brahma meditation cue; omit its outer text and glossy lighting.

must_show: The assembly gathered quietly on the breezy shore of the milky ocean
Brahma in the foreground hearing Hari's words inwardly, one natural hand near his heart
Other deities meditating with calm varied faces
Brahma's exactly four heads and four arms
scene_brief.composition: Use the sea as a calm horizontal ground; Brahma's inward attention is focal while the assembly forms a restrained arc behind him.

stanzas.alt: At the milky ocean, Brahma hears Hari's words within his heart

landscape.composition_override: Set Brahma on one side and the calm assembled devas across the shore; maintain natural eye lines and connected hands.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #5 to 005.jpg (SHA-256 6819ab14925ec2ebb561d7098362aaa7e96093ee4ade35a5bef13d1cbb663743). Use only Brahma's four-headed identity as a cue; remove gloss, text, metallic reflections and copied pose.

must_show: Brahma conveying the plan to the assembled devas
A small and restrained inner vision of four-armed Hari in a cloud-blue field, matching approved Vishnu identity only
Subtle symbolic suggestion of Yadava and Vrishni lineages receiving the divine plan
Brahma's anatomy exactly four heads and four arms
scene_brief.composition: Brahma speaks from the foreground while the group listens; the vision is a modest inset of light within the natural painted space.

stanzas.alt: Brahma shares Hari's promise to incarnate among the Yadavas

landscape.composition_override: Keep Brahma and listeners spread horizontally; place the small divine vision above the speaking gesture without crowding faces.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #6 to 006.jpg (SHA-256 d2b84683ddef4e8c31f8a58c63af03556240e2bb93044e4aae468be2a0fd7a7e). Treat as a simple paired portrait cue; make an original Mathura wedding scene.

must_show: Vasudeva and Devaki joining hands in a dignified wedding rite in Mathura
Vasudeva with the approved face, beard, tilak and plain cream clothing vocabulary
Devaki in the approved maroon sari and small bindi
A restrained temple courtyard and a few distinct witnesses
scene_brief.composition: Place the couple at the center in a balanced horizontal composition, with ritual gesture and faces unobstructed.

stanzas.alt: Vasudeva and Devaki marry in Mathura

landscape.composition_override: Give the couple room on both sides for a small wedding party while keeping the joined hands fully visible.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #7 to 007.jpg (SHA-256 105d0b9f389e97fce4ff3d6051fc40e35eec976c0c696b4d8490cc99f3947604). It contains a violent chariot scene; retain only the procession and threat premise, without copying pose or showing injury.

must_show: Kamsa driving the newly married couple's chariot through Mathura
A subtle unlettered sky-light signifying a divine voice
Kamsa startled and turning toward Devaki, with a sword held away from her
Vasudeva alert and protective; Devaki composed and unharmed
scene_brief.composition: Keep the three faces and chariot readable in a side view; place the sword low and separated from Devaki's body.

stanzas.alt: A divine prophecy interrupts Kamsa's chariot procession with Vasudeva and Devaki

landscape.composition_override: Show chariot motion across the frame while preserving clear spacing between Kamsa, the couple and the safely lowered sword.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #8 to 008.jpg (SHA-256 e0cbc41aedcb5b089a9860f0cb6ad77b2aeff57289cdd11c8369194d3bc311cb). Exclude all stock marks; use its family-and-king arrangement only as reference context.

must_show: Vasudeva entrusting the first newborn to Kamsa after promising to surrender each child
Kamsa holding the unharmed infant gently and relenting
Devaki visibly present in the prison chamber
Natural human anatomy and clear hand-to-child contact
scene_brief.composition: Make the infant's safe transfer the emotional center; keep all adult hands visibly supporting or released from the swaddled child.
scene_brief.tone: fear held in check by an unexpected moment of mercy

stanzas.alt: Vasudeva gives the first newborn to Kamsa, who chooses to spare the child

landscape.composition_override: Use a calm horizontal handover with the child fully visible and safely supported between the adults.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #9 to 009.jpg (SHA-256 c835010c615833ad60341d971c7df21995dc3d16e10aa9c8a4c28f71223e111f). Use only the conversation premise; omit every stock watermark and copied character.

must_show: Narada speaking calmly to Kamsa in a Mathuran interior
Kamsa listening with growing alarm
A discreet symbol of the six lost children, such as six extinguished lamps, with no infants or violence shown
Narada and Kamsa as separate natural two-armed people
scene_brief.composition: Build an intimate conversational axis with clear eye lines; the six lamps remain secondary and unambiguous.

stanzas.alt: Narada warns Kamsa of Hari's birth among the Yadavas as six lamps mark the lost children

landscape.composition_override: Keep both faces at eye level across a sparse interior; place six small lamps low in the frame.

stanzas.reference_mapping: Accepted readiness maps caption #10 to 010.jpg (SHA-256 6b1d5e664d9377f0972765b1389b951128b2e06a981e48b2799579f5bdf67bb8). Use the maternal devotion and infant symbolism only; invent no literal anatomy beyond the stanza.

must_show: Devaki and Rohini shown separately in calm Mathuran settings
A small ivory-white serpent-light symbol moving from Devaki toward Rohini to signify Adishesha's transfer
A second deep-blue divine light entering Devaki to signify Hari's eighth incarnation
A few devas praising from above as quiet witnesses
scene_brief.composition: Use a balanced two-part landscape with a continuous soft painted light path; retain each woman's full natural figure and modest clothing.

stanzas.alt: Adishesha's light passes to Rohini as Hari enters Devaki, praised by the devas

landscape.composition_override: Compose Devaki and Rohini in distinct spaces across the wide frame, with the transfer represented by one graceful luminous path.
